title: Ester Expósito Debuts in Romantic Thriller on Prime Video
seoTitle: Ester Expósito debuts in romantic thriller on Prime Video
subtitle: The Mercedes Ron adaptation tops viewership charts in Spain
excerpt: Mercedes Ron's new adaptation, Enfrentados: Marfil, arrives on Prime Video starring Ester Expósito and already leads the most‑watched movies list in Spain.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Ester Expósito's debut in "Enfrentados: Marfil" on Prime Video generated huge buzz, propelling the film to the top spot among the platform's most‑watched titles in Spain just days after its release.

Enfrentados: Marfil Arrives on Prime Video

The feature film was added to Prime Video's catalog on September 9, as part of the "House of Ron" deal between writer Mercedes Ron and the streaming service to adapt her literary works.

Plot Synopsis

Marfil Cortés, played by Ester Expósito, is the daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman living in New York. Her seemingly perfect routine shatters when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires bodyguard Sebastián Moore, portrayed by Hugo Diego García, to protect her. The forced proximity between the two evolves from conflict to a growing attraction, while threats and family secrets intensify.

Cast and Production

Alongside Ester Expósito and Hugo Diego García, the film features Eric Masip (Iván), Pablo Molinero (Alejandro), Zoe Bonafonte (Gabriela), Lluís Homar (Logan) and Joaquín Ferreira (Ray). Direction was handled by Óscar Pedraza, known for works such as "Patria" and "Vivir sin permiso", and the script was written by Sofía Cuenca. Production comes from Pokeepsie Films, a company linked to Álex de la Iglesia and Carolina Bang, responsible for titles like "30 monedas" and "El bar".

Relation to Mercedes Ron's Work

"Enfrentados: Marfil" adapts the first volume of Mercedes Ron's duology "Enfrentados". The author participated in the crucial stages of adaptation, ensuring the film retained the romance, intrigue and suspense atmosphere present in the books. The sequel, "Enfrentados: Ébano", has already been produced, though a release date has not yet been set.

Reception and Catalog Positioning

Combining sentimental drama, suspense and strong chemistry between the leads, the film quickly stood out in Prime Video's catalog, occupying the number‑one spot among the most‑watched productions in Spain. The success reinforces the platform's strategy of adapting youth romance novels that already have a large reader base.

Impact on Ester Expósito's Career

For Ester Expósito, the production represents a new foray into an internationally‑oriented project, expanding a career that includes "Élite", "Venus" and the miniseries "Alguém tem que morrer". The role of Marfil places the actress at the center of a story that blends romance and thriller, increasing her visibility beyond television series.

With information from El Espectador, El Confidencial.
